title: MRA Grant Page Content
description: MRA Grant page sections, in the order they appear: hero, the MRA-in-short statement, what the grant covers, who can apply, our solutions, the Google Reviews slider, what you can expect and the final CTA. Only one block on this page is new to the theme — the centred statement with the ring around “70%” — and the three accreditation marks under it are theme artwork rather than fields, like the two on the PSG Grant page. Everything else is a section another page already draws, so the two ticked lists are the same component with different values and their fields are grouped by section above. This frame writes no FAQ, so unlike most pages there are no faq_* fields here and the page draws no FAQ section. The testimonials_* and cta_* field names repeat the other pages’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. Leave a field empty and the design’s own copy renders instead: because the theme treats an empty value as “use the design default”, a field that ships with copy cannot be blanked from here, only replaced.

fields.name: ci_hero_title
fields.instructions: The design sets this at 64px across three lines. This frame draws no brush stroke under it, so the length is free — unlike the other hero frames.
fields.default_value: Secure a government supported Grant to reach new international markets

fields.name: ci_hero_text
fields.default_value: MRA (Market Readiness Assistance Grant) MRA Grant is a grant by Enterprise Singapore for established local SMEs to help them to improve their market knowledge, strengthen their capabilities and expand their networks, as well as to connect them to partners and opportunities overseas.

fields.instructions: Leave empty to keep the design’s photograph. An upload is placed in the photo’s own slot and the yellow badge is drawn back over its left edge.

fields.label: Statement
fields.name: ci_statement_text
fields.instructions: The ring around “70%” is placed against this sentence breaking into five lines at 40px. A much shorter or longer sentence will circle different words; the ring is desktop-only either way.
fields.default_value: To help local SMEs get a foothold in overseas markets, the Market Readiness Grant was set up to provide funds to take the first steps. The MRA will cover up to 70% of eligible costs (capped at S$100,000) for each company in each new market.
